description: From PR #482, the Overview tab renders the L03 Intent card from the seeded, fresh pr_intent row: author claim, a supported point, scope, confidence, and the model it was derived with. The seeded intent's fingerprint matches the seeded PR, so it is not stale and opening the PR triggers no generation and no model call. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
